stories.title: Georgia makes case for No. 1 ranking, runs past Bama
stories.summary: Dwight Phillips Jr. ran for 120 yards to help Georgia stake its claim to the No. 1 ranking with a 20-17 victory over No. 6 Alabama on Saturday night.

stories.title: DeBoer rues DB Lee's lack of 'emotional maturity' on costly personal foul
stories.summary: Alabama coach Kalen DeBoer questioned sophomore cornerback Dijon Lee Jr.'s "emotional maturity" after his personal foul penalty extended a Georgia drive and secured the Bulldogs' 20-17 victory Saturday night.

stories.title: Red River redemption: Oklahoma's last-second FG stuns No. 1 Texas
stories.summary: John Mateer led the Sooners on a game-winning drive to shock the Longhorns 27-24 on Saturday.

stories.title: Guardians knock out White Sox, cap ALDS comeback with historic 21-K night
stories.summary: Pitching on a day's rest, Gavin Williams had 12 of the Guardians' record 21 strikeouts in a 2-0 win over the White Sox on Saturday to clinch the best-of-five ALDS after losing the first two games.

stories.title: Sources: Cardinals finalizing deal to trade WR Harrison Jr.
stories.summary: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
